findings.description: Critical: The high-water remediation stores only transition_sequence, while projection identity also includes phase. After reconcile(phase=A, sequence=N), a delayed keyed submit(phase=B, sequence=N) passes the equal-sequence check and the tuple-level unique index permits a second active row; the same advisory lock merely serializes this recreation. The claimed single-current-row invariant therefore still fails for an equal-sequence, different-phase tuple.
findings.resolution: Store and validate the complete authoritative generation in the head (at least phase plus transition_sequence), or reject any equal-sequence key that differs from the head's canonical phase. Specify that reconciliation advances the complete head atomically and add forced reconcile-first/different-phase-submit-second and concurrent same-sequence/different-phase PostgreSQL tests.

findings.description: Nit: The tasks require 409 mappings for stale_projection and reconciliation_required, but neither /work/submit nor /work/reconcile declares a 409 Problem response in the OpenAPI contract. An implementation can satisfy the task while failing the published transport contract, or satisfy the contract while omitting the planned conflict behavior.
findings.resolution: Add the applicable 409 Problem responses to both operations and pin their machine-readable conflict reasons in API tests, or explicitly choose another documented status and make design, tasks, specs, and contract agree.

findings.description: Nit: Round-one remediation added test_mcp_work_projection.py only to the coordinator package gate. The final wp-integration transport suite still omits that direct-MCP module, so the final integration checkpoint can pass without re-running the dedicated parity coverage that task 1.7 requires.
findings.resolution: Include agent-coordinator/tests/test_mcp_work_projection.py in the wp-integration coordinator transport command, or use a bounded test target that necessarily includes it.

findings.description: The persist-first callback and resume reconciliation preserve loop-state as one-way authoritative truth across projection failures and process crashes.
findings.resolution: Preserve the save-before-callback, failure-tolerance, resume-before-phase, and no-readback tests during implementation.

findings.description: The remediated plan now identifies the existing submit_work authorization operation and a reconciliation-specific mode, eliminating the round-one privilege-contract ambiguity.
findings.resolution: Preserve the authorization mapping and denial-envelope tests across HTTP, direct MCP, proxy MCP, and CLI.
